slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: Lillo and Mantegna 2003: reproduce an Omori exponent p for a major crash within the range the paper reports, using the same threshold-exceedance method.
Phase-randomized surrogate test: 100 surrogates, report p-value for the attractor statistic; claim supported only at p < 0.05.
